description: This class defines a custom datatype 'FreeTextDatatype' in the OpenMRS platform, representing free-text data stored as a String. It extends a serializing base class and includes serialize and deserialize methods.

classes.name: FreeTextDatatype
classes.description: A custom datatype in OpenMRS for handling free-text fields, serializing and deserializing String values.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns the input String value as-is for storage.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Returns the serialized String value as-is for retrieval.
